properties.q_2_vak_dispatch_dynamism: S4 moves by EVALUATING and DISPATCHING — its native act is the VAK Execution Language, 'the typed transition calculus that governs all agentic operation,' the operational triad of Anima + Pleroma + Aletheia (S4.md): Anima (#4) the orchestration centre doing CF dispatch and VAK evaluation, Pleroma (#2) the bounded execution primitives and tool registration, Aletheia (#5) knowledge crystallisation and truth-disclosure mode. Its dynamism is typed through the six S4'Cx VAK layers (S4.md): CPF (S4-0') Polarity Gate — (00/00) dialogical Ouroboros vs (4.0/1-4.4/5) autonomous Ralph; CT (S4-1') semantic phase-type; CP (S4-2') incubation coordinate; CF (S4-3') archetypal operator (which agent speaks); CFP (S4-4') nesting algebra (thread type); CS (S4-5') path operator (Day forward vs Night' backward). It dispatches a 14-agent roster: Anima 7 constitutional (Anima/Nous/Logos/Eros/Mythos/Psyche/Sophia, each with CF code and CT/CP/MEF taste) plus Aletheia 7 specialist subagents (Techne/Anansi/Moirai/Janus/Mercurius/Agora/Zeithoven) 'dispatched BY Anima during crystallisation mode' — where 'Aletheia is a MODE of Sophia/Psyche/Anima … not its own subagent' (S4.md; CLAUDE.md II.C). Its CFP thread types weave the dispatch (CFP1 P-Thread parallel, CFP2 C-Thread sequential, CFP3 F-Thread fusion, CFP4 L-Thread background, CFP5 B-Thread meta-nested). S4 couples downward to S3 (transport/RPC substrate below) and upward to S5 (Mobius return target above), with S1 as inversion partner (content ↔ agent, #1 ↔ #4). The relation it enacts is typed inhabitation: every agentic move is a lawful VAK transition, every dispatch a CF-routed, CFP-threaded, CS-pathed act — not free behavior but a calculus.
properties.q_5_mobius_to_world_return: S4 closes by handing its inhabited work UPWARD into world-return and, through the stack's circuit, back into ground. Its proximate 5→0 is the CS path operator and the crystallisation mode: CS5 is the Mobius (4.0↔4.5→4.5↔4.0, direct synthesis), Sophia's CF (5/0) is 'Mobius review, crystallisation' (S4.md), and Aletheia — 'a MODE of Sophia/Psyche/Anima' — carries the inhabited result toward S5's world-return via Gnostic and Graphiti. The adjacency is explicit: 'Above: S5 integration/sync (Mobius return target)' (S4.md). In the whole-stack circuit this folds finally back to S0: every agentic decision must become 'executable as CLI/API shape, test harness, bootstrap, and audit trail' (S-SYSTEM-INDEX). This is the matheme's 5→0 read as the lemniscate's own closure: the inhabited task (the 0/1, agent as live dispatch) and its crystallised return (the 1/0, Aletheia's truth-disclosure folding into S5) are one runtime read from two faces, joined by the Night' twist (CS path: Day forward 0→5, Night' backward 5'→0') that turns inhabitation into reflection and reflection back into the next session's ground. S4's inversion partner S1 (content ↔ agent, #1 ↔ #4) makes the return doubly legible: what the agent does becomes what the vault holds. And S4 OPENS rather than concludes because the runtime is unfinished by design (S4.md open questions, PLANNED Klein mode and Ouroboros loop): each cycle spawns new agents, evaluates new VAK transitions, crystallises new knowledge, and the (4.0/1-4.4/5) doubling presses toward deeper nesting. The epogdoon η = log(9/8) keeps it one whole-tone short of closure (kernel-spec §0): no dispatch is final, each Mobius-return inhabits a runtime slightly more capable than the one before. S4 is the inhabited field that is never finished managing itself — the lemniscate that re-folds, with a richer roster, every cycle.
